current.text: He is a deep bench player. The 10th spot in the rotation is open between him, Patrick Williams and Zach Collins.
With Caleb Wilson, Matas Buzelis and Nick Claxton ahead of him, he does not have a clear path to a real role.
If Buzelis or Wilson got hurt, he would likely start and play about 25 minutes.
He is a stash option only in formats that make stashing easy. He is 22 and played well late last season.

durable.text: He is an active two-way player who crashes the glass and can play the 3, 4 and 5.
Steals are a clear weakness, well below the league pool.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 363, ESPN rank 309). He went undrafted in our league last season, and he is not a pick in a 144-player auction. His projected line is about 6 to 7 points and 3.4 rebounds with few steals and few threes. His value depends on an injury to Buzelis or Caleb Wilson, so leave him on waivers. Check early whether new coach Splitter makes him the 10th man, and add him quickly if one of those two forwards goes down.
